metric: Custom BigQuery edge cases (three-valued logic, precedence, CTEs, DISTINCT, QUALIFY, SAFE_, casts, UNNEST, PIVOT) plus seeded fuzz cases; accepted rewrites are executed in DuckDB before and after and compared.
caveats: All cases are custom (379 hand-written, 588 seeded fuzz), none from a public benchmark. Held-out: 662 fresh-seed fuzz cases, 421 rewritten, 0 wrong. Baseline before fixes: 1 wrong (lifting dropped UNPIVOT, and the prover called it equivalent). A rewrite suite can pass by changing nothing; 539 declined (533 with lifting). Literal folds spot-checked on real BigQuery.
correctness: 0 behaviour-changing accepted rewrites; checked by executing both versions in DuckDB
